body: AUDIT-DERIVED ACCEPTANCE REFINEMENT, not a bead claim. I would keep one physical presentation coordinate (film PTS) and put distinct typed evidence layers on it: ShotBoundaryMeasurement versus CodedSceneBoundaryJudgment. The Sherlock disagreements up to 3 s show the claims differ, not necessarily that the coordinate axes differ. Epistemic status must attach to the emitted claim plus receipt, not to the tool tier: raw frame/audio bytes are artifact observations; TransNet, Whisper/diarization, captions, and tracking are model derivations/proposals even when measurement-like. An ASR transcript is Stage 1b input, not itself a PropositionChart, and natural-language video captions likewise remain proposal material until typed extraction and deterministic resolution. SSv2 is a useful motion-sensitivity admission gate but cannot certify narrative action alone; add local counterfactual courts for direction/order with identical objects, role binding, interval localization, and identity continuity across cuts. This preserves the audit's central limit: better features do not manufacture missing roles, relations, contexts, or stable situation identities.
